Name: Sticky-note Calendar (Content Patcher)
Author: plumprumps
Description:
Replaces the boring default calendar texture with one chock-full of sticky-notes and to-do lists! Created using assets originally found in[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9156323] LavenderLight's[/url] mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1573]A Toned Down Stardew Valley[/url].

This mod was created for use with Content Patcher. All you have to do is extract the [CP]Sticky-note Calendar folder into your [b]/mods[/b].

([size=1]This was tested using my own previously-modded xnb, so if I missed any stray pixels, please let me know! The image included contains assets from mods that are NOT my work![/size])
